behaviors.action: Select a cutscene Button in the Inspector and choose its Timeline action.
behaviors.expected: Nearest owner resolves to Responsive Canvas; no Script2D is required.

behaviors.action: Play the game, enter a player name with IME, then activate Play, Pause, Skip and Resume.
behaviors.expected: The title fades, music plays, Pause retains position, Skip shows Arrival and Resume returns to Introduction.

behaviors.action: Edit a caption translation and switch the project preview locale.
behaviors.expected: Menu labels and captions resolve the selected language; English fallback remains available.

behaviors.action: Edit the actual timeline and animation assets; save both drafts, save the project and reopen it.
behaviors.expected: Only saved values reach the reopened runtime and no retained draft is silently lost.

behaviors.action: Build Web and launch only the downloaded archive.
behaviors.expected: The exact edited sequence, menu actions, music, captions and input work in the standalone player.
